ORDINANCE II OF 1978
ORDINANCE II OF 1978
FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1978
1. Short title
and commencement.‑(I) This Ordinance may be called the Finance
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1978.
(2) It shall come into force and shall be deemed to
have taken effect on the first day of July 1977.
